title: PAR-134 HATCH gradient CMC ByLayer and ByBlock methods
mode: spec-backed local implementation with generated fast controls
scope: Decode supported R2004+ CMC C0 ByLayer and C1 ByBlock method payloads for HATCH/MPOLYGON gradient stops
Emit explicit C0/C1 CMC method bytes for validated gradient stop tuples
Preserve DXF group-63 ACI 256/0 mappings in ASCII and Binary DXF
Keep unknown CMC methods and invalid method/value combinations fail-closed

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local copy /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf
odaDwgSpecification.finding: The R2004+ CMC record has a reserved zero BS followed by a method-packed color BL and optional-name flags. Existing libdxfrw getCmColor() maps C0 to ACI 256 (ByLayer) and C1 to ACI 0 (ByBlock).

evidence.decision: Support only the standard C0/C1 tuples whose 24-bit payload is zero; retain fail-closed behavior for C4-C7 and other unimplemented CMC methods.

changes.reader: src/drw_entities.cpp accepts C0/C1 only with zero low-24-bit payload and retains rgb=-1 with ACI 256/0.
changes.writer: src/intern/dwgbufferw.cpp and .h emit C0/C1 CMC values only for matching explicit tuples; src/drw_entities.cpp routes validated gradient stop metadata through the method-aware writer.
changes.dxfMapping: src/drw_entities.cpp maps group 63 values 256 and 0 to C0/C1, and src/libdxfrw.cpp retains both values during HATCH/MPOLYGON gradient output, including explicit ACI zero.
changes.generatedTests: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp checks independent C0/C1 wire fields, AC1018 inline parsing, and AC1024 generated file readback plus following-LINE alignment. tests/wave1_tests.cpp checks ASCII and Binary DXF output and parsing for group-63 values 256 and 0. The direct AC1018 verifier consumes inline optional CMC CP8 text between stops.

commands.command: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.cpp src/drw_entities.h src/intern/dwgbufferw.cpp src/intern/dwgbufferw.h src/libdxfrw.cpp tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp tests/wave1_tests.cpp

limits: Generated controls are locally authored test data, not independent producer samples.
CMC C4-C7 and other unimplemented methods remain unsupported.
This does not establish complete HATCH/MPOLYGON gradient semantics or consumer acceptance.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
No persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added; the shared worktree remains broadly dirty and the slice is uncommitted.
next: Continue PAR-03 associative-action dwgResbufValueKind context research only with an exact ODA consumer field layout; keep remaining CMC methods, broader gradient semantics, and independent external/platform qualification separate.
